description: Manage OpenVibe.Network's owner settings (D11): GET /internal/owner-settings answers platform.owner-settings@1 and PATCH changes typed values with platform.owner-settings-change@1 (a key with source env is 409 settings.pinned_in_env); PUT /internal/owner-settings/secrets/:key sets a secret once with platform.owner-secret-put@1 (write-only) and DELETE removes it. The first set is its dev API keys and the default project budget. Only Network's admin proxy, acting for the owner, holds this capability; it is never grantable to apps. Each request carries the owner as actor, and the service audits every write with that actor and key, never the value.
